=== bi-json-keys
--- main
!$o = {"a": 1, "b": [1, 2], "c": {"d": true}, "a": 2}
!$arr = [1, "x", {"k": 1}, {"k2": 2, "k": 3}, [{"z": 0}]]
A : %get_json_keys($o) %get_json_keys($arr) %get_json_keys($o.c)
!$e = {}
A : %get_json_keys($e)
=== bi-json-keys-not-json
--- main
A : %get_json_keys("str")
=== bi-json-keys-number
--- main
!$o = {"a": 1}
A : %get_json_keys($o.a)
=== bi-json-type
--- main
!$o = {"a": 1, "b": [1, 2], "c": {"d": true}, "n": null, "s": "txt", "f": 1.5}
A : %get_json_type($o) %get_json_type($o.b) %get_json_type($o.c) %get_json_type($o.c.d) %get_json_type($o.a)
A : %get_json_type($o.n) %get_json_type($o.s) %get_json_type($o.f) %get_json_type("s") %get_json_type(1) %get_json_type("")
=== bi-json-add
--- main
!$o = {"a": 1}
!$arr = [1]
A : %json_add($arr, 5) %json_add($arr, "s") %json_add($arr, $o) %json_add($o, "z", 1) %json_add($o, "a", 2)
A : %json_add($o, "z", "str") %json_add($o, "z", $arr) %json_add($o.a, 1) %json_add($o.a, 1, 2) $o $arr
!$x = %json_add($arr, 2)
!$x = %json_add($x, 3)
A : $x $arr
=== bi-json-add-not-json
--- main
A : %json_add("str", 1)
=== bi-json-add-object-two-args
--- main
!$o = {"a": 1}
A : %json_add($o, "z")
=== bi-json-key-exists
--- main
!$o = {"a": 1, "c": {"d": true}}
!$arr = [{"k": 1}]
!$s = {"name": "a"}
A : %json_key_exists($o, "a") %json_key_exists($o, "zz") %json_key_exists($arr, "k") %json_key_exists("str", "a")
A : %json_key_exists($o, 1) %json_key_exists($o.c, "d") %json_key_exists($o, $s.name) %json_key_exists($o, "")
!$k = %json_key_exists($o, "c")
A : $k %json_key_exists("x")
=== bi-json-key-exists-one-arg-object
--- main
!$o = {"a": 1}
A : %json_key_exists($o)
=== bi-json-key-exists-one-arg-expression
--- main
!$o = {"a": 1}
!$k = %json_key_exists($o)
=== bi-json-merge
--- main
!$o = {"a": 1, "b": 2}
!$p = {"a": 9, "e": 3}
!$arr = [1, 2]
!$arr2 = [3, {"x": 1}]
A : %json_merge($o, $p) %json_merge($arr, $arr2) %json_merge($o, $arr) %json_merge($arr, $o)
A : %json_merge($o.a, $o.b) %json_merge($o, $o) $o
=== bi-json-merge-number-array
--- main
!$o = {"a": 1}
!$arr = [1, 2]
A : %json_merge($o.a, $arr)
=== bi-json-merge-not-json
--- main
!$o = {"a": 1}
A : %json_merge("x", $o)
=== bi-json-merge-not-json-second
--- main
!$o = {"a": 1}
A : %json_merge($o, "x")
=== bi-json-remove
--- main
!$o = {"a": 1, "b": 2, "a": 3}
!$arr = [1, 2, 3]
A : %json_remove($arr, 0) %json_remove($arr, 2) %json_remove($arr, 3) %json_remove($arr, -1) %json_remove($arr, "0")
A : %json_remove($o, "a") %json_remove($o, "zz") %json_remove($o.b, "x") %json_remove($o, 1) $o $arr
=== bi-json-remove-not-json
--- main
A : %json_remove("x", 1)
=== bi-json-set
--- main
!$o = {"a": 1, "c": {"d": 1, "x": {"y": 1}}, "a": 5}
!$arr = [1, 2, 3]
!$patch = {"c": {"e": 2, "x": {"z": 3}}, "f": [1]}
A : %json_set($arr, 1, "new") %json_set($arr, 3, 1) %json_set($arr, -1, 1) %json_set($arr, "1", 1)
A : %json_set($o, "a", 99) %json_set($o, "new", $arr) %json_set($o, $patch) %json_set($o, "str")
A : %json_set($o.a, "x", 1) %json_set($arr, "x") $o $arr
=== bi-json-set-not-json
--- main
A : %json_set("x", 1, 2)
=== bi-json-set-array-two-args
--- main
!$arr = [1, 2]
A : %json_set($arr, 1)
=== bi-json-set-one-arg
--- main
!$arr = [1, 2]
!$x = %json_set($arr)
=== bi-str2json
--- main
A : %str2json("[1,2]") %str2json('{"a": 1, "b": [true, null]}') [%str2json("bad")] [%str2json("")]
A : %str2json("123") %str2json('"s"') %str2json("true") %str2json(" [ 1 ] ") [%str2json("[1,")] %str2json(12)
!$j = %str2json('{"k": {"v": 42}}')
A : $j.k.v %get_json_type($j) %get_json_type(%str2json("x"))
=== bi-load-json
--- file: data.json
{"k": [1, 2], "s": "é"}
--- file: sub/x.json
[1, 2, 3]
--- file: empty.json
--- main
!$d = %load_json("data.json")
A : $d $d.k[1] $d.s
A : %load_json("sub/x.json") %load_json("missing.json") %load_json("missing.json", '{"x": 1}') %load_json("missing.json", "[]")
A : %load_json("empty.json") %load_json("empty.json", "[0]") %load_json("missing.json", "{}", "nocharset")
A : %load_json("data.json", "{}", "ISO-8859-1") %load_json("data.json", "{}", "UTF-8") %load_json("sub")
A : %load_json("<x>") %load_json("<>") %load_json(">foo<") %load_json("http://exa mple.com/x")
=== bi-load-json-bad-file
--- file: bad.json
{"k": [1, 2
--- main
A : %load_json("bad.json")
=== bi-load-json-bad-default
--- main
A : %load_json("missing.json", "{bad")
=== bi-load-json-bad-charset
--- file: data.json
{"k": 1}
--- main
A : %load_json("data.json", "{}", "nocharset")
=== bi-load-json-empty-charset
--- file: data.json
{"k": 1}
--- main
A : %load_json("data.json", "{}", "")
=== bi-load-json-sandbox
--- profile: SANDBOX
--- file: data.json
{"k": 1}
--- main
A : %load_json("data.json") %load_json("data.json", "[1]") %load_json("http://localhost:1/x", "[2]")
=== bi-load-json-stdlib-missing
--- main
A : %load_json("<nolib/x>")
=== bi-load-json-stdlib-short
--- main
A : %load_json("<")
=== bi-load-json-includepath
--- includepath: inc
--- file: inc/lib.json
{"from": "inc"}
--- main
A : %load_json("lib.json")
=== bi-json-inline-literal-arg
--- main
A : %get_json_keys({"a": 1, "b": 2}) %size([1, 2]) %json_add([1], 2)
